title: Review: a way back for suspended cards
reason: P29.REVIEW routing of review 5 (Operator Questions 13): the signed 08-review round gives Suspend only a short Undo, so a suspended quiz card has no way back (a highlight's card returns when Review this is turned on again). P30 keeps the suspended flag and its history (S3), so a later list can restore cards; the list is a new surface, so a design round comes first
trigger: a reader asks to restore a suspended card, or the operator wants it in v1 at P30's DECOMP
